reviewer_role: Independent metadata/statistical/provenance reviewer; bounded final report and freeze-rule audit
decision: No blocking issue. Adopt the reviewed stage report and freeze the exact six-gene exploratory object and single GSE23597 Week8 primary test specified in the hashed draft. This approves analysis-plan execution, not validation success or a novel biological state.
report_checks: Numerical claims and rounding agree with previously independently recomputed statistics, including the positive IFNG golimumab-minus-placebo coefficient and its two-sided interval.

CAMERA fixed versus estimated correlation are sensitivity assumptions; default correlation is not called a coding error. fry has a self-contained null and is not treated as an identical CAMERA replication.
Non-significant interaction does not establish equivalence or justify a common effect. Arm-adjusted pooled response associations remain exploratory conditional associations.
No expression-derived patient identities or new pairs are accepted. The 52/65 restricted-rank result explicitly includes 26 singleton-candidate cases.
Candidate selection is post hoc; all discovery P values remain exploratory and BH families are explicitly local, not global post-selection error control.

The candidate is strongly correlated with the published CT-colonocyte program (r=0.928722) and is not claimed as a new cell state. MARS means remain component proxies; IBrD 15/81 remains a partial-panel diagnostic, without original-score superiority claims.

freeze_checks.score: Equal-weight arithmetic mean log2 gene expression, post minus baseline for exact source-ID pairs; all six genes required.
freeze_checks.primary_test: GSE23597 Week8: delta_candidate ~ response + treatment_dose + baseline_candidate + delta_inflammatory_response; one two-sided OLS t test, alpha 0.05.
freeze_checks.support_rule: ResponseYes coefficient must be positive and two-sided OLS P<0.05; estimate, 95% CI and exact P reported regardless of outcome.
freeze_checks.identity_rule: Exact W0-W8 source-ID pairs; exclude unresolved P13 primary pair; expression similarity cannot repair identity.
freeze_checks.coverage_and_missingness: Frozen inflammation coverage >=80%; all six candidate genes; complete cases and full-rank estimable fixed model. Stated non-evaluability rules prohibit substantive covariate removal or gene replacement to obtain significance.
freeze_checks.robustness: OLS remains primary; HC3 is sensitivity and cannot replace the primary method based on significance.
freeze_checks.secondary_family: Three frozen reference programs; BH across the three secondary tests with source coverage >=80%.
freeze_checks.threshold_timing: 80% coverage and remaining rules documented as fixed before independent validation expression access.
freeze_checks.frozen_input_hashes: All seven current input hashes match.
freeze_checks.no_tuning: No outcome-dependent changes to genes, weights, direction, endpoint, covariates or thresholds; any changed object requires a separate exploratory version and independent evidence.

figure_checks.patient_scatter_panels: 65 unique subjects per panel; all scores, response and arm labels match patient-level source data.
figure_checks.visual_qa: Root analyst reported viewing all four PNGs and fixing facet-label spacing. This reviewer audited plotting code, source data and manifest; did not independently rerender or visually inspect the PNGs in this final bounded pass.

scope_limits: No external validation expression was accessed by this reviewer.
No previously reviewed statistical model was rerun in this final pass; it relies on the linked prior independent recomputations plus exact source-table and report checks.
No additional literature search was performed; this bounded review is not a new comprehensive novelty or literature audit.

Stage adoption is compatible with an incremental publication-oriented study, but does not establish validation success, causal repair, drug equivalence, baseline prediction or superiority to original published scores.
Existing reviews, scientific scripts, raw data and current draft were not modified. The root analyst should create the final lock and preserve the reviewed draft/hash in provenance.
